name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement

## Problem / motivation

What gap or limitation are you hitting? What use case does this enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like. How does it fit the local-first, privacy-preserving
design of the project?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Links, papers, or prior art that informed the idea.
